title: A Multi-wavelength Analysis of Dust and Gas in the SR 24S Transition Disk
question: How do the dust (0.45 and 1.3 mm) and gas (13CO, C18O) distributions in the SR 24S transition disk compare with dust-trapping models, and is the northern companion SR 24N detected?

data.bands: Band 6 (1.3 mm) new; 0.45 mm Cycle 0 archival

what.value: 0.45 mm Cycle 0 continuum data of SR 24S (project 2011.0.00724.S)

evidence.quote: The details of the calibration process for the Cycle 0 data are presented in (cite: perez_L2014).

what.value: Mid-plane temperatures from dust radiative transfer models of SR 24S

evidence.quote: For the physical temperature, we assume the mid-plane values from dust radiative transfer models for SR 24S in (cite: marel2015).

what.value: Dust opacity at 1.3 mm of ~3 cm2/g

evidence.quote: a dust opacity at 1.3 mm of $\sim3\,$cm$^{2}$g$^{-1}$ (cite: andrews2011)

recipe.goal: Find disk center, PA and inclination and recenter
recipe.method: uvmodelfit with Gaussian/disk model on short baselines or all uv; center checked by minimizing scatter of imaginary visibilities; fixvis to recenter
key_parameters: short baselines <~200 kλ or full uv

recipe.goal: Image continuum and CO lines; derive fluxes, moment maps
recipe.method: clean with Briggs/natural weighting, uvcontsub, moment-0 maps from -1.35 to 10.8 km/s

recipe.goal: Dust masses and integrated spectral index
recipe.method: Optically thin mass formula; alpha_mm from total fluxes at 0.45 and 1.3 mm; SR 24N upper limit from 3 sigma_N in 1" circle
assumptions: d = 137 pc, kappa(1.3 mm) ~3 cm2/g, T = 20 K

recipe.method: Fit real part of visibilities with three axisymmetric ring models (Gaussian, asymmetric Gaussian, Gaussian+power law), separately at each wavelength; PA and i from 1.3 mm fixed for 0.45 mm
key_parameters: radial grid 1-500 au in 0.1 au steps; 4000 steps, 1000 walkers, burn-in ~1000 steps

recipe.goal: Spectral index profile and optical depth
recipe.method: Spectral index from best-fit intensity profiles; tau from brightness temperature of de-projected azimuthally averaged image without Rayleigh-Jeans
assumptions: Mid-plane temperature from van der Marel et al. 2015 models

answer_key.quantity: Ring peak radius, symmetric Gaussian, 1.3 mm
Ring peak radius, symmetric Gaussian, 0.45 mm
Cavity depletion at 1.3 mm vs 0.45 mm

evidence.quote: the flux is reduced by around 85%

not_stated_but_needed: Image size and cell size for clean (pixel sizes only given in the fit section), masks, thresholds, iterations
CASA version/calibration details of Cycle 0 data
Temperature profile values taken from van der Marel et al. 2015
Starting values/initialization of emcee walkers; uv binning of visibilities
Which channels formed the moment-0 maps beyond velocity range
missing_for_reproduction: Line-free channel ranges, clean masks and image/cell sizes for imaging
Temperature profile from van der Marel et al. 2015
score_reason: Data identified and fit models/priors well specified, but imaging and Cycle 0 details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA data are archival projects, fitting recipe and priors are given, and main results are numeric (ring parameters, fluxes, alpha_mm).
